method: Web search and direct primary-source reading; papers inform mechanisms and are not evidence of Spark product qualification.

sources.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
sources.supports: Meaning of grouped-query attention and the KV-head storage tradeoff.
sources.limit: Does not evaluate Spark or prove its exact quality/speed tradeoff.

sources.title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free
sources.supports: Architectural comparison to a head-specific sigmoid gate after attention.
sources.limit: No assertion that Spark derives from this paper or that the gate accounts for X2.6 gains.

sources.title: MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Integration in LLM Post-Training
sources.supports: Method background for distilling domain-specialized teachers on student rollouts.
sources.limit: Inspected text names Qwen3-30B-A3B and MiMo-V2-Flash, not Spark; no Spark match in text search.

sources.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
sources.supports: A trained native-memory architecture with Gated DeltaNet-2, Mixture-of-Storage, and backbone preparation.
sources.limit: Does not validate the project's Spark plastic-expert retrofit; no Spark match in inspected text.

sources.title: Nested Learning: The Illusion of Deep Learning Architectures
sources.supports: Learning levels as optimization problems with distinct context flows; HOPE as a concrete mechanism.
sources.limit: Multiple stores or clocks alone do not reproduce HOPE or demonstrate continual-learning gains.

sources.title: Conditional Memory via Scalable Lookup: A New Axis of Sparsity for Large Language Models
sources.supports: Engram conditional n-gram lookup as a separate memory/computation design.
sources.limit: Does not establish writable episodic learning, revocation or provenance contracts for Spark.

sources.title: Transformers KV cache strategies
sources.supports: Framework cache classes and logical sliding-cache behavior.
sources.limit: Physical slice-backing allocation is established by the separate local CPU probe.
